newsitem.title: UK: UK's Etam says H1 losses to widen further.
newsitem.headline: UK's Etam says H1 losses to widen further.

text.p: British womenswear retailer Etam Plc said on Thursday that difficult market conditions would affect its first-half trading results by about 2.7 million stg and would consequently widen its first-half losses compared to last year.
The company had announced in May annual pre-tax losses of 5.37 million stg on a turnover of 187 million stg.
The company, however, said that in the last three weeks its like-for-like sales were ahead by three percent and total sales rose one percent.
The company's share price was marked 12 pence down at 117 1/2 p after its statement.
